task: two-level heterogeneous 6-UAV recovery: fixed role controllers plus a learned team-level recovery option policy

methods.direct_fault_aware: non-compositional MLP over context and the fixed primitive-fault registry
methods.additive: shared primitive-fault main effects with no pair interaction
methods.acfid: additive effects plus shared action-conditioned pair effects using causal task-relation descriptors

training_support: nominal + all singles + one frozen balanced subset of pairs
validation_support: training-support combinations with disjoint context seeds; never held-out combinations
test_support: held-out pairs + all frozen triples + frozen quadruples

pilot_pass_rule.seed_direction: ACFID improves held-out action regret and mission success over additive in at least 2 of 3 seeds
pilot_pass_rule.direct_baseline: ACFID is non-inferior to direct fault-aware policy on success and better on at least one compositional endpoint
pilot_pass_rule.mechanism: removing pair interactions reduces held-out-combination performance
